summary: Frontend-only test of 5 POS improvements + regression. ALL 7 test groups PASS at 1280x900 desktop with ZERO console errors. Verified end-to-end: (1) CashierGate blocks /pos until cashier login, (1b) sidebar nav-pos shows lock badge '🔒', (2) warm aurora background renders (orange/amber/red visible), (3) auto-print toggle ON by default, window.print() triggered after sale, reprint-last-button appears + works, .print-area Receipt rendered with customer/items/TOTAL, /orders shows 5 print-order-{i} buttons, (4) product form inputs render visible text — name input color=rgb(242,242,242) on bg=rgb(17,20,42) at rest AND on focus (no longer white-on-white), option input color=rgb(236,236,241) is also clearly visible, (5) ImageEditor opens after file upload with all 7 controls (zoom-slider, zoom-in-btn, zoom-out-btn, rotate-btn, reset-edit-btn, cancel-edit-btn, confirm-edit-btn); confirm returns a data:image/jpeg URL that populates form.image. Regression: login (demo@restaurant.com/demo1234) → /pos → cashier PIN gate (PIN 1234) → unlocks → add product → checkout cash $1000 → sale registered → auto-print fires → reprint works. /orders, /stats, /cash-register, /settings all render with h1 visible.

issues: Cosmetic only (carry-over from iter_4): Emergent badge bottom-right may overlap mobile bottom-nav rightmost tab — not in scope for this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: ImageEditor uses container.getBoundingClientRect() inside handleConfirm AFTER reading current scale/translate — math is approximate; the resulting crop is close but not pixel-perfect to what user sees because background fill uses '#0B0E1A' (could be transparent for cleaner JPEG, but JPEG doesn't support alpha — acceptable).
POSPage.jsx now ~566 lines and growing — consider extracting CartContent, ProductCard, SkeletonGrid, EmptyState into separate files (>500 line threshold).

Receipt component is rendered into the DOM at fixed position left:-10000px — works for window.print() but increases DOM weight permanently after first sale. Could conditionally render only during print or use a portal. Low priority.

auto_print localStorage default uses string 'false' check; if key is unset, default is true (correct), but 'auto_print' is global per browser — not scoped per restaurant. Could cause cross-tenant leak if multi-restaurant on same browser. Low priority.
(carry-over from iter_4) server.py >850 lines, legacy /api/auth/login endpoints still present — not addressed in frontend-only iteration.
test_credentials: demo@restaurant.com / demo1234 (restaurant); cashier 'siko' with PIN 1234 already existed; created+used 'TestCashier1' PIN 1234 too

One TEST sale was registered with customer 'TestCustomer' on cashier 'siko' (visible in /orders). Did NOT save the TEST_VisibleText product — modal was dismissed via Escape after image-editor flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 user-requested improvements are working correctly. CashierGate is enforced (data-testid='cashier-gate'). PIN flow works with [data-testid='gate-cashier-{id}'] → [data-testid='gate-pin-input'] → [data-testid='gate-submit-btn']. Auto-print is via [data-testid='auto-print-toggle'] inside checkout modal, persisted to localStorage 'auto_print'. Reprint via [data-testid='reprint-last-button'] appears in POS header only after a sale. Image editor [data-testid='image-editor'] opens after [data-testid='product-image-input'] receives a file. Receipt component renders .print-area with customer name + total. Warm aurora colors confirmed visually (orange/amber gradients clearly visible in screenshots).
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues. All 5 improvements verified functional end-to-end.
